summary: Frontend-only cleanup verification of public pages with empty DB (/api/v1/notices -> {items:[],total:0}). PASS on page load: Home (/ and /notices), /tenders/live, /tenders/all, /notices/PMC-NOT-9999-0000, /m/e/public, /m/e/supplier and /tenders/completed (AwardsPublicE) all render honest empty/not-found states. No fabricated titles, refs, budgets or awards appear on load, and there are no page errors. FAIL on one interaction: on the Home 'Open for bids this week' section, clicking the All/Tender/RFP/RFQ chips makes the 4 hidden placeholder .pmc-tender cards visible again. They show blank titles, '—' budget/EMD/delivery/category, and made-up countdowns (0m, 0m, 1m, 4m taken from hardcoded data-in=52/57/83/270). The week-empty message still shows beside them.

ui_bugs.component: Home 'Open for bids this week' type chips (PmcHomeFilters.jsx lines 40-46)
ui_bugs.issue: filter() sets card.style.display='' on every .pmc-tender whose tag matches, including the hidden, unfilled templates. With 0 notices, clicking All shows 4 ghost cards, Tender shows 2, RFP 1 and RFQ 1. Each has a blank title, '—' values and a made-up countdown (0m/1m/4m) from the hardcoded data-in attributes. Once notices exist, 'All' would also reveal any unused template slots beyond openItems.length.

issues: No public top nav/header or footer is rendered (only a breadcrumb), unlike the other E public pages. The user has no header navigation back to Home or Sign in.
React warning: the password input uses value='••••••••' without onChange/readOnly (MobilePublicE.jsx line 37). Use defaultValue or readOnly.

action_items: Fix PmcHomeFilters.jsx filter(): only show cards that live data has filled. For example, have pmcELiveData set data-pmc-filled='1' on populated cards (around line 474) and remove it on hidden ones (line 476). In filter(), always keep unfilled cards display:none, and hide or keep the week-empty state consistent.
Remove the hardcoded data-in countdown seconds (52/57/83/270) from the HomeE.jsx .pmc-tender and .pmc-live__row templates (use data-in='0'), so no made-up countdown can ever show.
Optional: add the public header/footer to AwardsPublicE; fix the read-only password input warning in MobilePublicE.
critical_code_review_comments: Route /tenders/live renders apps/notice-board/TendersList.jsx (React-state, honest empty state 'No live tenders match this filter.', '00 entries'), NOT notice-board-e/TendersListE.jsx. TendersListE is not routed anywhere (dead code). The review request's '0 results' and Tender/RFP/RFQ chip expectations refer to the unmounted component. Either wire it up or delete it.
/awards and /mobile are not real routes; they fall through to the Home page. The real routes are /tenders/completed (awards) and /m/e/public and /m/e/supplier (mobile mockups).

Fake tender strings (IVF Laboratory, Birth Suites, PMC-NOT-2026-...) still exist in non-public files: vendor-portal-e/VendorAlertsE.jsx, VendorEmdE.jsx, admin-console-e/AdminEvaluationListE.jsx, and reference-e/DialogsE.jsx, EmailsE.jsx, PrintablesE.jsx. These are outside this request's public scope; consider cleaning them in the same way.
pmcELiveData.js is 2030 lines. It should be split into smaller modules.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (6 of 6 pages clean on load; 1 interaction bug on Home chips)
